execution_table.rows: all fit roster rows in stream/seed/row order
all tune roster rows in stream/seed/row order
all assessment roster rows in stream/seed/row order

gate_predicates: at least two primary families pass adjusted p<=0.05 and mean D<0 including delayed_reward, drift, or long_horizon
complete_policy beats lambda_zero and matched_random in at least one family with mechanism-family adjusted p<=0.05
always_skip is worse than fixed_sgd_b1 on predictable_noise
complete_policy is not better than noise_floor on pure_noise
all resource and adaptation predicates pass

holm_groups.adjustment: sort raw p then family order; adjusted=max(previous,(m-rank+1)*p) clipped 1
sort raw p then fixed test order; adjusted=max(previous,(m-rank+1)*raw_p) clipped 1
sort raw p then fixed test order; adjusted=max(previous,(m-rank+1)*raw_p) clipped 1

ablation_execution_multiplicity.paired_test: mean of per-seed D; sample sd denominator n-1; t=mean/(sd/sqrt(n)); p=erfc(abs(t)/sqrt(2)); zero variance gives p=1 for mean=0 else p=0

adaptation_metrics.aggregation: never scan across a shift; report per-segment, per-seed, per-stream, and family summaries
adaptation_metrics.baseline: median of exactly the 16 pre-shift pre-update losses at rows [shift-16,shift)
adaptation_metrics.censoring: if no qualifying pair before next_shift, lag=next_shift-shift; for final shift lag=segment_stop-shift
adaptation_metrics.controls: same boundaries and windows for every arm; baseline is arm-specific pre-shift loss and is computed before the shift
adaptation_metrics.lag: first qualifying k plus 16 minus shift; integer rows until two windows are complete
adaptation_metrics.primary_temporal_endpoint: per-seed maximum lag over declared shifts, then stream mean, then family mean
adaptation_metrics.recovery_scan: for candidate k from shift through next_shift-16 inclusive, compute adjacent means on [k,k+8) and [k+8,k+16); require both <=threshold and both windows wholly inside the segment
adaptation_metrics.segments: use each stream's exact segments array; a shift at s starts segment s and ends at the next boundary
adaptation_metrics.stationary: no adaptation lag is defined when segments has one boundary [0,rows]

controller_transition_table.pending_rule: every pending_* field is either consumed and overwritten within the indexed transition sequence or reset at boundary; undeclared state is invalid
controller_transition_table.row_251_rule: for 252 rows, row 251 records pre-update loss and terminal reward for row 250; no model action occurs on row 251

rows.order: reset trajectory fields before row 0; theta and dual_mu persist only across fit trajectories
predict then compute finite half-squared loss before any write
compute q_skip and q_apply from pre-update theta; fit uses hash exploration; tune/assessment use locked greedy; ties apply
execute selected action after prior credit; apply performs exactly one fixed-rate SGD update; skip performs no parameter write
if pending_valid, credit prior action before current model action; reward uses previous_mu_at_action snapshot
publish current action and all fields needed by the next row; no implicit state
row 251 supplies terminal reward for row 250 with q_current=0 and gamma=0; no row-251 model action
append one canonical counter row after every observe action

generator_roster.draw_policy: each row consumes the exact roster below in listed order; conditional branches select or zero already-drawn values and never draw again
generator_roster.source_id_layout: utf8('cohort:stream_id:data_seed:local_row') with decimal data_seed and local_row, used only for custody and never as controller input

delayed_reward_v5.equation: 28 episodes of nine rows; phase=row mod 9; cache cue from phase 0 and consume unused cue every row; x=(cue,phase/8,1[phase=8],1); y=0 for phase<8 else mapping*cue+0.05*z; mapping=+1 for episodes<14 else -1

event_camera_v5.equation: deduplicate three indices without redraw; force x0=(-1 if row even else +1) while retaining all draws; y=(1 before row126 else -1)*x0+0.15*z

long_horizon_v5.equation: xi=2*ui-1; maintain a 32-row ring of x0; y=ring_x0_32_rows_ago+0.1*z with zero prefill; coefficient sign reverses at rows 84 and 168

noisy_mnist_v5.equation: label=row mod 2; if label=1 set indices 377,378,405,406 to 1 else index 377 to -1; add forty drawn signed distractors; y=(2*label-1)+0.2*z

action_hash.decision: apply iff uint256_be(SHA256(frame)) < threshold; otherwise skip
action_hash.probability_encoding: rational p_num/p_den; threshold=floor(p_num*2^256/p_den), never binary floating comparison

hash_prng_transcript.digest_encoding: lowercase hexadecimal with exactly 64 ASCII characters
hash_prng_transcript.draw_transcript_row: cohort_id,stream_id,data_seed,row,draw_ordinal,draw_label,raw_uint64,derived_value; every listed draw is consumed even when its value is ignored

field_encodings.hex_digest: decode exactly 64 lowercase/uppercase hex characters into 32 bytes

hash_prng_transcript.file_bytes: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, exactly one final LF; source digest is over these exact bytes
hash_prng_transcript.frame: LP32(payload)=u32_be(byte_length(payload))||payload for variable UTF-8 fields; fixed digest/uint32/uint64 fields are raw fixed-width bytes with no length prefix; concatenate fields in declared order
hash_prng_transcript.source_digest: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of v5_protocol_spec.json; whitespace changes the digest
hash_prng_transcript.transcript_test_vector_rule: compiler emits root initialization state, first 12 raw SplitMix64 outputs, first uniform53, first normal12, and action-hash digest for fit/stream/data_seed/row=(fit,sparse_predictable_v5,4000,0)

lock_counter_control_schemas.assessment_materialization_rule: assessment files, rows, and effects must not exist before an accepted tune lock and independent validator receipt; absence is itself a required digest-bound artifact
lock_counter_control_schemas.schema_encoding: each schema is an ordered list of field objects; validators reject missing, extra, reordered, wrong-type, nonfinite, or duplicate fields

fit_controller_state.bytes: 6*8+6*8+8+8+1+8+1+1=123 logical bytes; canonical packed layout rounds no field and reports 123
fit_controller_state.offsets: packed in listed order with float64 alignment; uint8 fields follow float64 fields

lock_receipt.encoding: canonical JSON UTF-8; no platform struct packing

controller_formulas.action_fit: 6 multiplies+5 adds+1 comparison+1 hash+1 threshold comparison
controller_formulas.action_locked: 3 multiplies+2 adds+1 comparison+6 scalar feature operations
controller_formulas.sarsa_fit: 48 multiplies+31 adds+6 writes+1 dot-product reduction+1 clip

model_formulas.active_parameter_writes: 1 per nonzero gradient coordinate including bias if apply

operation_and_byte_algebra.operation_units: one multiply, add, comparison, division, min, max, clip, counter increment, parameter write, hash invocation, or PRNG draw each counts one; no fused-operation credit
resource_invariants: replay_bytes=0 unless an explicitly named replay arm is present (none in V5)
one Experience item per observe call
joules are separate measured fields and never inferred from operations
peak bytes are max of declared model, controller, pending, counter, and lock layouts

identification: candidate and reference start from byte-identical zero model states
candidate and reference consume identical ordered rows and one row per observe
assessment actions are deterministic from the locked controller
assessment seeds are independent experimental units
candidate controller state never mutates during tune or assessment
estimand.name: paired complete-policy cumulative pre-update loss effect
estimand.scope: complete-policy trajectory including carryover from every earlier action

stop_rules: reject compilation if any required field, type, roster, draw, formula, ablation, metric, or schema is missing or extra
reject review if compiler output is nondeterministic or digest recomputation differs
do not implement or execute V5 before independent ACCEPT over exact source, compiler, compiled artifact, and current AGENTS bytes
close V5 on review rejection or any later parity, lock, custody, statistics, resource, energy, or validator failure; do not retune
never reopen plasticity guard or reuse V1-V4 artifacts as scientific inputs
real streams require a separate authorization, fresh campaign manifest, and new privileged energy receipt
